description: Inspect or change a JSON file in the workspace through aos-json. Use target FILE#/POINTER (a JSON pointer, for example fsm.json#/states/think; a file alone means the whole document). Start with peek and unfold one level at a time to find the place to change. Writes (except del) validate the JSON value and the resulting aos configuration before saving; invalid changes are rejected so you can retry.

cmd.description: peek: inspect a level as a summary; get: read a complete value; where: locate the file storing the value; set: replace target with value; batch: change several pointers at once (target is a file, value is {"/pointer": value, ...}); del: delete; append: add value to an array; merge: merge the keys of value into an object; check: validate the document.

target.description: FILE#/POINTER, for example fsm.json#/states/think/exec. The file must be relative to and remain inside the workspace, including after resolving symlinks; absolute paths and .. components are rejected.

value.description: Value to write for set, append, merge or batch; supply JSON directly (a string, number, object, array or other JSON value).

depth.description: Number of levels for peek to unfold (0-5; default 1).
